newsitem.title: INDIA: India GAIL 95/96 sales up to 16.5 bln cubic metres.
newsitem.headline: India GAIL 95/96 sales up to 16.5 bln cubic metres.

text.p: The state-run Gas Authority of India Ltd's (GAIL) gas sales in fiscal 1995/96 (April-March) rose to 16.5 billion cubic metres from 13.7 billion in the previous year, the company said in a statement on Tuesday.
The company produced 611,000 tonnes of Liquified Petroleum gas (LPG)/Propane/Solvent compared to 423,000 tonnes last year, the statement said.
It said GAIL's annual turnover increased to 42 billion rupees in 1995/96 from 33.6 billion in the previous year.
The company was setting up four LPG plants at a cost of around 45 billion rupees, which would produce an additional 850,000 tonnes of LPG, the statement said.

GAIL also has plans to built a 1,500 km (937 miles) long pipeline to transport LPG, which would cost less than transporting LPG by road or rail, the statement quoted the company's chairman C.R. Prasad as saying.
